name: Switcher
title: switcherstudio.com
shortDescription: Switcher Studio transforms your iPhones, iPads, and cameras into a multi-camera streaming studio, allowing you to capture events from multiple angles. It's designed for creators, educators, and event organizers who want to enhance their live streaming capabilities without investing in expensive equipment. Users can stream simultaneously to platforms like Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram, integrate multimedia assets, and engage with their audience in real-time.
cons: Limited to iOS devices and cameras
May require high bandwidth for multiple streams
